snippet.title: PROJECT NEOS - ALPHA TESTING - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Project NEOS is an original sci-fi project where you'll be escaping from a space station that's entirely governed and controlled by an AI system. You'll need to use your wits, cunning, and instincts in order to survive. Think John Wick meets Ellen Ripley. We are currently holding Alpha playtests and would love you to try it out!
